cards.ex: We need to iron out the details of the contract before signing.
cards.exUz: Imzolashdan oldin shartnomaning tafsilotlarini hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni bartaraf etmoq, muammolarni hal qilmoq.

cards.ex: The government should ensure a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Hukumat barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoit yaratishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: They keep moving the goalposts, making it impossible to reach an agreement.
cards.exUz: Ular qoidalarni o'zgartirishda davom etmoqda, kelishuvga erishishni imkonsiz qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni yoki maqsadlarni kelishuvdan keyin o'zgartirmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiation involved a quid pro quo: lower prices for faster delivery.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar 'evaziga evaz'ni o'z ichiga oldi: tezroq yetkazib berish uchun pastroq narxlar.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsa uchun boshqa narsa berish (almashish).

cards.ex: We need to find the sweet spot between cost and quality.
cards.exUz: Biz xarajat va sifat o'rtasida eng yaxshi nuqtani topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eng qulay yoki maqbul nuqta yoki holat.

cards.ex: If this deal falls through, we're going to take a bath.
cards.exUz: Agar bu kelishuv amalga oshmasa, biz katta zarar ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Katta moliyaviy zarar ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: The company has been operating in the red for the last two quarters.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya oxirgi ikki chorakda zarar bilan ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarzdorlikda, zararda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase sales.
cards.exUz: Asosiy natija shuki, biz sotuvlarni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi natija, muhim fakt yoki xulosa.

cards.ex: She's a skilled negotiator and knows how to close a deal.
cards.exUz: U tajribali muzokarachidir va kelishuvni qanday yakunlashni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatli kelishuvga erishmoq va uni yakunlamoq.

cards.ex: It took weeks to hammer out the details of the partnership agreement.
cards.exUz: Hamkorlik shartnomasining tafsilotlarini ishlab chiqish uchun haftalar kerak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan kelishuvga erishmoq, ishlab chiqmoq.

cards.ex: The political debate turned into a lot of horse trading.
cards.exUz: Siyosiy munozaralar ko'p savdolashuvga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq savdolashuv, o'zaro manfaatlar uchun kelishuv.

cards.ex: Let me run it by my boss before I give you a final answer.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy javobni berishdan oldin, xo'jayinimga ko'rsatib olay.
cards.uzDef: Boshqasiga ko'rsatib, fikrini so'ramoq.

cards.ex: They reached an agreement at the eleventh hour, just before the deadline.
cards.exUz: Ular oxirgi daqiqada, muddat tugashidan oldin kelishuvga erishdilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning oxirgi daqiqasida.

cards.ex: This internship will help me get a foot in the door in the industry.
cards.exUz: Bu stajirovka menga sohada yo'l ochishga yordam beradi.
cards.term: get a foot in the door
cards.uzDef: Biror tashkilotga kirish uchun dastlabki imkoniyatni qo'lga kiritmoq.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade; this project is a failure.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni aytamiz; bu loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri, ochiqchasiga aytmoq.

cards.ex: After years of losses, the company is finally in the black.
cards.exUz: Yillik zararlardan so'ng, kompaniya nihoyat foydada.
cards.uzDef: Foydada bo'lish, qarzda bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to increase our market share to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun bozor ulushimizni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning bozorning qancha qismini nazorat qilishi.

cards.ex: This deal is a win-win for both companies.
cards.exUz: Bu kelishuv har ikki kompaniya uchun ham yutuqli.
cards.uzDef: Har ikki taraf uchun ham foydali bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: After months of planning, they finally decided to take the plunge and start their own business.
cards.exUz: Oylik rejalashtirishdan so'ng, ular nihoyat tavakkal qilib, o'z bizneslarini boshlashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki xavfli qaror qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: In negotiations, you need to be able to think on your feet.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralarda siz tez fikrlay olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezkorlik bilan muammoni hal qilish yoki javob berish.

cards.ex: Before making any decisions, you need to understand the lay of the land.
cards.exUz: Har qanday qaror qabul qilishdan oldin, vaziyatni tushunishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki holatni to'liq tushunish.

cards.ex: Our value proposition is that we offer high-quality products at affordable prices.
cards.exUz: Bizning qiymat taklifimiz shundaki, biz yuqori sifatli mahsulotlarni arzon narxlarda taklif etamiz.
cards.uzDef: Nima uchun mahsulot yoki xizmat sotib olish kerakligini izohlovchi bayonot.

cards.ex: To stay ahead of the curve, we need to invest in research and development.
cards.exUz: Oldingi qatorda bo'lish uchun biz tadqiqot va rivojlanishga investitsiya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: So'nggi o'zgarishlardan xabardor bo'lish va rivojlanish.

cards.ex: The company was facing a burning platform, and needed to make drastic changes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qutqaruv vaziyatiga duch keldi va keskin o'zgarishlar qilish kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor va muhim o'zgarishlarni talab qiladigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Successful negotiations require a lot of give and take.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli muzokaralar ko'p o'zaro yon berishni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvga erishish uchun o'zaro yon berish.

cards.ex: Now that I'm in the driver's seat, I can make the changes I want to see.
cards.exUz: Endi men rahbarlik lavozimida ekanman, ko'rishni xohlagan o'zgarishlarni qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Nazorat ostida bo'lish, boshqaruvda bo'lish.

cards.ex: This project has the potential to really move the needle for our company.
cards.exUz: Bu loyiha kompaniyamiz uchun haqiqiy ta'sir ko'rsatish potentsialiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarish yoki ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: We need to analyze our value chain to identify areas for improvement.
cards.exUz: Yaxshilash uchun sohalarni aniqlash uchun qiymat zanjirimizni tahlil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yaratishda ishtirok etadigan har bir qadam.

cards.ex: I've given you the initial concept, now you need to run with it.
cards.exUz: Men sizga dastlabki tushunchani berdim, endi siz undan foydalanishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: G'oya yoki imkoniyatdan foydalanib, uni rivojlantirmoq.

cards.ex: We've baked a contingency plan into our budget.
cards.exUz: Biz byudjetimizga favqulodda reja kiritdik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rejalashtirish yoki hisoblashga kiritmoq.
